title: Chapter 958
text:
Godora Star System, on a planet with a surface civilization, a spaceport.

A medium-sized tourist spaceship was parked at the spaceport. Several doors opened, and gangway ladders were lowered one after another. People carrying bags of various sizes lined up to board the spaceship.

This was a galactic flight to Blue Star, funded by the government. The people boarding the spaceship had a variety of backgrounds. Some were rich people who had bought seats, some were elites sent by the military, some were selected from the civilian population, and some were people who had bought seats at the bottom of the spaceship, wanting to leave their mother planet and change their destiny.

For a character like Black Star to appear on Planet Aquamarine, it was one of the lucky ones among the surface civilizations. In this Star System, there were many surface civilizations that were subordinate to Godora, and this planet was one of them.

It was as difficult as ascending to the heavens for a surface civilization that was born under the jurisdiction of an advanced civilization to develop. Although the civilization on this planet was not a stagnant pool, it obviously lacked the vitality to develop. Even this port was the only port on this planet. Throughout the year, there were not many interstellar visitors, which was a stark contrast to the prosperity of Planet Aquamarine.

The news of the Black Star Corps opening a Super Academy also reached this planet, and the upper echelons of this civilization immediately had thoughts.

For a small place like theirs, they naturally did not have the qualifications to invite the army to open an academy. If they wanted to enroll, they could only go to a pilot planet. Therefore, the upper echelons of this civilization specially organized this flight to Blue Star. The goal was to send military elites and youths with potential to the Super Academy opened by the Black Star Corps to further their studies.

For a surface civilization like this with limited development, it was almost impossible for them to surpass a Star System civilization in terms of raw strength. The technology that they treated as treasures was not worth mentioning in the eyes of the advanced civilizations. Therefore, the only path they could take was the path of Supers. As long as they could nurture a powerful individual, they would be able to raise the status of the entire civilization. Blue Star was an example of the envy of countless surface civilizations.

Of course, they did not even dare to think about nurturing a cosmic figure like Black Star. The greatest hope of this civilization was to produce a Calamity Grade Super.

The civilian academy opened by the Black Star Corps gave them some hope …

The strongest academy in the Star Field should have a higher chance of nurturing a Calamity Grade, right?

In the noisy long line, a dark and skinny little girl stood in the crowd. She was surrounded by four soldiers who blocked the crowd and protected her from being pushed around. It was obvious that she had received special treatment.

"Uncle, what's a Blue Star like?"

The dark-skinned girl held a cloth doll in one hand and held the corner of a soldier's shirt with the other.

She was very young, and her eyebrows and eyes had yet to fully develop. However, upon closer inspection, she could be considered delicate and pretty. It was just that her skin was dull and a little dirty. However, her pair of large eyes were shining with a lively radiance.

"Blue Star? I haven't been there either, but I heard that it's a bustling place," the soldier replied with a good attitude.

"Then, when are we coming back?"

"I don't know. It depends on the higher-ups."

"Oh …" The dark-skinned girl hugged the doll tightly and felt a little uneasy. She had an instinctive fear of the unknown life.

She was an abandoned orphan and had been taken in by a public orphanage. Not long ago, the government did a comprehensive potential test for all the children in the public orphanage. Some of the orphans were selected by the government and sent into this training team. She was one of them.

To her, her peaceful days were suddenly broken. It was as though everyone was arranging her life. She did not know what was going on and could only accept any arrangement like a marionette. No one told her the reason. She only knew that she was about to leave the orphanage that she had stayed in for a long time, say goodbye to her friends, and head to an unknown planet to learn something.

"Black Star Super Academy … what kind of place is that?"

…

Blue Star, Black Star City. A brand new floating island was floating above the city.

This floating island was the first Black Star Super Academy campus, and it had all the necessary facilities.

With the help of the galactic construction team, the construction speed was unimaginably fast. The productivity of the galactic era was extremely high, and all kinds of construction printers were produced endlessly. This floating island, which was equivalent to an independent city, only took less than half a month to complete. They even spent a few days to draw the blueprint.

Ever since the announcement of the opening of the academy was made, a large number of people came to the various pilot areas. A large number of galactic residents who lived nearby gathered.

The first phase of the Black Star Corps was preparing to open dozens of academies in the Godora Star System. Blue Star was the most eye-catching one because this was the home planet of the Black Star. Everyone knew that the Blue Star Super Academy would definitely receive the most resources. This was definitely the best Black Star Super Academy.

In just over ten days, the Blue Star Black Star Super Academy received countless applications. Luckily, Han Xiao had the foresight to build a huge floating island campus. It would not be a problem to accommodate a few million people, and it could continue to expand in the future.

In order to expand its influence, the school fees were not expensive. It did not take the route of an aristocratic school and was very close to the people.

However, the school did not provide accommodation. There were many residential areas in the campus that could be rented or bought. Han Xiao did not expect the school fees to cover the cost. He had specifically asked people to build a set of real estate. This was the main source of the money.

Don't ask. If you did, it would be the school district.

The thing that the Black Star Corps did not lack the most was teachers. A large number of Supers were happy to earn extra money. They treated it as accepting the job of teaching students. There were also many ready-made Super Academies for reference. Blue Star was so prosperous. As long as they had money, they could recruit all kinds of employees. They did not need to worry about the source of students. Furthermore, with the name of Black Star, the administrative approval process was smooth. No one dared to stand in their way.

In the galactic era, efficiency was the most important thing. Therefore, the first batch of Black Star Super Academies was ready in less than a month. Taking advantage of their popularity, they directly recruited a large number of students and started school on the spot.

Riding the floating school bus all the way to the floating island, many of the freshmen on the bus were shocked.

The tanned and skinny girl was one of them. Her experience during this period was like a dream. She had seen countless spectacular scenes, and all of them had shocked her soul.

"Country bumpkins." Another group of freshmen who came from wealthy families could not help but look down on this group of ignorant students.

It's just a floating island. What's there to be surprised about? Look at all of you who have not seen the world. If you see the honorary principal in person, you will probably faint.

Hearing the sarcasm of others, many of the freshmen who came from small places lowered their heads in low self-esteem. They could only hold back their exclamations and secretly glance at the scene outside the window.

The tanned and skinny girl sat by the window. She wore a simple dress that could be called plain. Beside her was a Godora freshman who was dressed extravagantly. At this time, he moved away in disgust. It seemed like he was very unwilling to sit with the tanned and skinny girl.

Many orphans had a sharp observation ability to detect good intentions and bad intentions. Noticing the rejection of the students beside her, the tanned and skinny girl could not help but pinch her dress, causing it to wrinkle slightly.

The floating school buses arrived at the floating platform of the school one after another. The freshmen on the buses alighted, and a huge crowd quickly gathered, waiting for the teachers to lead the way.

The tanned and skinny girl was not used to places with so many people. She hugged her luggage tightly and stood in the crowd, not knowing where to go.

At this moment, there was a commotion not far away. The surrounding students seemed to have discovered something and looked over excitedly.

"That's Nero, the son of Blue Star's leader?"

"That's right, that's him. I heard that he studied under Black Star for a few years and even became Black Star's godson."

"I'm so envious. I also want to call Black Star Daddy."

"I didn't expect such a person to study with us. It will definitely be beneficial to have a good relationship with him."

"It's a pity that he looks too young. If not, I would definitely pursue him. As long as I can get him, my future will be bright."

"… Classmate, leave this to us girls. You're a man, so don't get involved."

"Hey, wait, he's walking over."

In the eyes of ordinary students, Nero was the pride of this cohort. He was extremely short, rich, and handsome.

Hearing the discussions around her, the tanned and skinny girl was a little curious.

However, at this moment, the crowd suddenly surged. There was no one here to protect her, and she was suddenly pushed to the ground. Her luggage fell to the ground, and the skin on her knees was scraped.

"Ouch, it hurts …"

The tanned and skinny girl subconsciously wanted to cover her head and squat down to prevent others from stepping on her.

However, all of a sudden, the crowd around her seemed to have disappeared in the blink of an eye, and no one was pushing her anymore.

She opened her eyes in a daze and saw a flying shuttle floating above her head, forcing the surrounding crowd to retreat.

A youth with a childish face walked over with a face full of concern. He bent down and placed his hand in front of her.

"My name is Nero. I saw you fall just now. Are you okay?"

The tanned and skinny girl looked at Nero in a daze. In her eyes, the youth in front of her seemed to be covered in a layer of warm gold.

After staring at him for a few seconds, the tanned and skinny girl woke up from her daze. She hurriedly grabbed Nero's hand and stood up to thank him with a voice as soft as a mosquito.

"Thank you … I'm not injured …"

Nero lowered his head and saw the bloodstains on her knees. He couldn't help but say, "Aren't you injured?"

"It's fine. It's just a small injury. I'll be fine in a few days."

"Wait, I have a healing spray."

As he spoke, Nero placed his mechanical bag on the ground and took out a metal spray with the Black Star logo. He squatted down and sprayed a circle around the tanned and skinny girl's knees before nodding his head in satisfaction.

After he stood up, he realized that the young girl's face was flushed red and she looked uneasy.

Seeing this, Nero couldn't help but laugh. "What are you nervous about? Oh right, I haven't asked you yet. What's your name?"

"My … my name is Mia Morotto. This … this is the name given to me by the orphanage director." The tanned and skinny girl nervously held onto her skirt and didn't dare to look at Nero.

"Orphanage? You're an orphan? "Nero was surprised.

"Hmm …"

Nero scratched his head and thought for a moment before passing the healing spray to Mia. "This is for you. If you're injured in the future, use this to heal faster."

He had observed Mia's plain clothes and realized that she was an orphan. Her financial situation should not be good.

Nero knew that there was a high risk of injury when learning Supers, so he gave the bottle of healing spray to her. After all, it was just a small matter, and he had as many of these as he wanted.

Mia mustered her courage and looked at Nero. When she met Nero's sincere gaze, her heart trembled. Like a frightened rabbit, she quickly lowered her head and carefully received the potion from Nero.

"Thank you …"

…

Pa!

Han Xiao, who was monitoring Nero's enrollment, covered his face with his hands.

"It hurts my eyes!"

What the f * ck, what is this? Is this a Jack Sue Show?

At such a young age, he can pick up girls on his own?

Nero, did I ask you to do this?

This puppy love must be stopped! Otherwise, my [Perfect Mechanical Sense] might be replaced by a talent like [Female Affinity]!

However … why does this Mia Morotto sound so familiar?

Han Xiao frowned. He searched his memories and locked onto an image.

It was a tall woman wearing tight black armor. Her face was originally exquisite and beautiful, but now it was disfigured. Half of her face had become mechanical prosthetics, and one of her mechanical eyeballs was emitting a strange red light, making her look hideous and hideous. Her expression was cold, and she held a black metal spear in her hands. Drops of blood dripped down from the tip of the spear, and she gave off a murderous aura.

[Conqueror] Mia Morotto, Calamity Grade Pugilist, once a Beyond Grade A seed. She lost part of her limbs in a battle and cut off her path to becoming a Beyond Grade A Super. She was one of the followers of Hella in my previous life …

Han Xiao blinked his eyes. It was difficult for him to connect the image of that female calamity in his memories with this weak and tanned girl.

Rubbing his temples, Han Xiao looked at Nero with a complicated expression.

This was truly the treatment of a main character. He had casually met a little friend with great potential.

The Advanced Luck Glow … is terrifying!

I'm impressed!

When will I get one too? I'll trample on the Goddess of Luck a hundred times!

Not wanting to look at Nero's scene, Han Xiao helplessly turned off the surveillance camera and looked at the modification workbench not far away.

After a month of hard work, not only had the mechanical soldiers in his inventory been upgraded, but the Mech Legion had also expanded to a scale of close to twenty million. The prototype of the secondary dimension factory had also been created. All that was left was to refine it and turn it into a military factory in the secondary dimension.

"My efficiency is still as high as ever."

Looking at the neat Mech Legion, Han Xiao chuckled with satisfaction.

Di di di!

Right at this moment, Han Xiao's quantum network vision suddenly sounded an alarm.

The next moment, Philip suddenly appeared and hugged Han Xiao's finger. His face was pale, and white noise kept appearing on his virtual image, as if he had not been in contact with Han Xiao.

"A large amount of abnormal data has been detected. It's breaking through my core firewall. Daddy, save me, hum!"
